'''Zinn Classet''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He led a team of hunters including fellow Human [[Andar Sizzton]], [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] [[Jargool Muus]], [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Uthil Ren'kacal]], and [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] [[Negollup]]. He owned a [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Zinn's Revenge]]'',<ref name="Sins" /> a modified [[CorelliSpace]] [[Gymsnor-3 light freighter/Legends|Gymsnor-3 light freighter]].<ref name="Sins2" /> During the Galactic Civil War, Classet and his hunters were contracted by authorities at the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]] to hunt down a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] operatives who had liberated a [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] named [[Kentara]] they had purchased<ref name="Sins" /> on [[Deysum III]].<ref name="Enslaved">{{WEGCite|story=Rebel Enslaved!|book=Star Wars Gamemaster Kit}}</ref> He wore red and green battle [[Armor/Legends|armor]], and carried two modified [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]].<ref name="Sins" />
